about.heading: The Best Weed Dispensary in East Lansing, Michigan
about.md:
High Society Cannabis in East Lansing is a leading fully integrated cannabis dispensary, dedicated to delivering outstanding customer service and offering a diverse selection of premium cannabis products. By managing every aspect of the cannabis journey—from cultivation to retail—High Society ensures consistent quality and excellence.

Our cannabis collection features renowned brands like 710 Labs, Bloom, Camino, and Drip, celebrated for their exceptional quality and potency. This commitment to excellence has solidified High Society Cannabis as a top choice for the best weed in East Lansing.

items.title: Who Can Shop
items.md: Individuals 21 years or older can shop recreationally.

items.title: Check In
items.md: Present a government-issued ID or passport upon arrival and check in with our security and front desk team.

items.title: Stay in the Loop
items.md: Stay updated on special deals and discounts by providing your phone number and email address.

items.title: Meet Your Budtender
items.md: A budtender will call you from the waiting area when it’s your turn. They’ll assist with product selection and address any questions, whether you’re a first-time visitor or a returning customer.

items.title: Choose Your Items
items.md: After finalizing your choices, the budtender will notify our order preparation team. Payments are accepted via cash, credit, or debit cards.

items.title: Complete Your Purchase
items.md: When your order is ready, a staff member will call your name, process the payment, and review the items with you to ensure everything is correct before completing the purchase.

blocks.heading: How to Place an Order for Dispensary Pick-Up

items.title: Browse the Menu
items.md: Explore our [East Lansing dispensary menu](/shop/east-lansing/) online or reach out to us at [(517) 708-8043](tel:+15177088043) for any assistance.

items.title: Build Your Order
items.md: Select your desired products, set quantities, add them to your cart, and choose a convenient pick-up time.

items.title: Check Out
items.md: Finalize your order by entering your details. New visitors will need to provide a valid ID for verification, while returning customers can log in for a quicker checkout.

items.title: Curbside Pickup
items.md: Prefer curbside pickup? Let us know, and we’ll send a text when your order is ready for collection.

items.title: Enjoy Responsibly

items.q: What do I need to shop at High Society Cannabis East Lansing?
items.a: To make a purchase, you must present a valid government-issued ID verifying you are 21 or older. Individuals aged 18 and up with a medical marijuana card are also eligible to shop.

items.q: What should I do if I receive a defective product?
items.a: If there’s an issue with the quality or functionality of a product, contact us at [(517) 708-8043](tel:+15177088043) or visit the store where the purchase was made. Our team is ready to assist.

items.q: Can I pay with a debit card or cash at High Society?
items.a: Yes, both debit cards and cash are accepted. For added convenience, ATMs are available at all dispensary locations. Contact your nearest store to confirm available payment methods.

items.q: Is it legal to travel with cannabis?
items.a: While cannabis purchases are legal in Michigan, federal law prohibits transporting cannabis across state lines. Please avoid taking cannabis products out of the state.

items.q: What products are available at the dispensary?
items.a: Our selection includes a variety of premium cannabis products such as flower, pre-rolls, concentrates, vape pens, edibles, and more. Browse our menu or reach out with specific questions.

items.q: Can I earn rewards for shopping at High Society?
items.a: Yes! By joining our loyalty program, The Society, you’ll earn points on every purchase. Redeem these points for discounts and special perks—ask about signing up during your next visit.
